sentences.text: This FIR was lodged by Ms. Gauri Singh against Smt. Asha Singh, Phool Singh, Ashish Singh and Anupam Singh.

From the text of the FIR, it has been culled out that the informant is under the possession of 17, George Town, Allahabadand and having old bungalow over 15/23, new number 31/23, Hamilton Road, Amarnath Jha Lane, Prayagraj and she has executed the agreement to sell to one Ajay Kumar Shukla on 05.08.2020.
Out of blue, yet another agreement to sell alleged to have been executed by the informant in favour of Asha Singh.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has strenuously argued that after paying the amount of Rs.five lacs, this agreement to sell was executed by the informant in favour of Asha Singh on 14.11.2019.

At this juncture, learned counsel for the informant has strenuously argued that this agreement to sell dated 14.11.2019 is forged piece of paper and no such agreement to sell was ever executed by the informant.

To this effect, one FIR was lodged by Ms. Gauri Singh on 23.08.2020 and after inordinate delay of almost three years, the present writ petition was filed when the non-bailable warrants are executable against the petitioners.
We have gone through the FIR and from the facts and circumstances, it is evident that cognizable offence is made out against the petitioners.

However, it is submitted by the petitioners that petitioners are ready to cooperate with the investigation provided non-bailable warrant shall be kept in abeyance for another period of 15 days from today.

Accordingly, non-bailable warrants against the petitioners are stayed for a period of 15 days from today provided that the petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer and cooperate with the investigation.
If the petitioners fail to cooperate in the investigation, it is open for the police officials to use all available coercive action in the Code of Criminal Procedure against the petitioners.
In addition to this, it is expected from the court to conclude the investigation within next 60 days from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
With the aforesaid observations, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 22.5.2023
